dedupe_keys.name: gtfs scorecard daily plain language gtfs quality grades for small transit agencies

description: GTFS Scorecard is a daily data-quality service for small transit agencies and the programme staff, maintainers and vendors who support them. Its README says it publishes dated grades, prioritised fixes (the three things to fix and why each matters), history, programme views, practitioner tools and open data. It does not implement its own validator: correctness findings come from MobilityData's canonical validator, whose jar the pipeline downloads on first run. The pipeline needs Python 3.12+, uv and Java 17+ and fetches a daily snapshot of every configured feed. Coverage: the feeds configured in the project. Format and access: an open-source pipeline in a public repository. Licence and cost: Apache 2.0, free. Caveats: a young project; the README excerpt does not list which agencies are covered. It supports network flow studies by flagging feed quality before feeds are used in models. It relates to the canonical GTFS validator and the GTFS specification in the catalogue.
